proof_text:
have h_main : 15 * sumOfFourthPowerOfOddNumbers n h_precond = n * (2 * n + 1) * (7 + 24 * n ^ 3 - 12 * n ^ 2 - 14 * n) := by
    have h₁ : ∀ n : ℕ, 15 * sumOfFourthPowerOfOddNumbers n h_precond = n * (2 * n + 1) * (7 + 24 * n ^ 3 - 12 * n ^ 2 - 14 * n) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        simp [sumOfFourthPowerOfOddNumbers]
        <;> norm_num
        <;> rfl
      | succ n ih =>
        simp_all [sumOfFourthPowerOfOddNumbers, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul]
        <;>
        (try ring_nf at * <;> omega) <;>
        (try
          cases n with
          | zero =>
            norm_num at * <;> rfl
          | succ n =>
            simp_all [pow_succ, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul]
            <;> ring_nf at * <;> omega) <;>
        (try omega)
        <;>
        (try
          {
            cases n with
            | zero =>
              norm_num at * <;> rfl
            | succ n =>
              simp_all [pow_succ, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul]
              <;> ring_nf at * <;> omega
          }
        )
        <;>
        (try omega)
        <;>
        (try
          {
            simp_all [pow_succ, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul]
            <;> ring_nf at * <;> omega
          }
        )
        <;>
        (try omega)
    exact h₁ n
  have h₂ : 15 * sumOfFourthPowerOfOddNumbers n h_precond = n * (2 * n + 1) * (7 + 24 * n ^ 3 - 12 * n ^ 2 - 14 * n) := by
    exact h_main
  exact h₂
